jd_text: Krungthai Management Trainee Program for new graduates. Rotations across corporate banking, retail banking and digital. Requirements: bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics or related fields; minimum GPA 3.00; Thai nationality; graduating in 2026 or 2027. Programme starts July 2027.
